fire: The bank is a wholly owned subsidiary of New England Financial Group.

notes: Card: ' New' x8, ' The' x5, ' like' x2, ' Second' x2, ' Black' x2, after 'subsidiary of', 'company called', 'group'. Probe: 'subsidiary of New York Life' 0.948; 'company called Second Sight' 0.475; but 'companies like Moderna' 0.016 peaked on the name itself; 'an indirect part of' 0.011. Near misses keep the capitalized word or the frame but drop the company.
